}}'''Idrelle Menford''' was an [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]] before, during, and after the [[Schism]].

== Appearance ==
She is a lanky and hard-eyed young woman with a long nose.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Idrelle Menford}} Her frown is a fixture of her features.

== Activities ==
After being captured and reduced to the rank of [[novice]], [[Egwene al'Vere]] was placed in one of Idrelle's classes.

Idrelle tried to make an example of Egwene in front of the other novices by asking her to create a ball of fire, knowing full well the [[Forkroot]] Egwene was being forced to take would severely limit her channeling abilities.

In response Egwene made a fool of her by splitting her faint weaves to produce a multitude of colorful balls of fire at once, a skill that neither Idrelle nor a majority of Aes Sedai in the tower could match.
